description: What a field's empty NOTAM list says where NASR gives a private field no NOTAM_ID: it is outside the NOTAM system, so "No NOTAMs are issued for this private-use field." rather than none heard. Null where the ordinary empty state is right. (FAA JO 7930.2 could not be fetched to quote on 2026-11-13; the plainer wording was chosen for that reason.)

private.description: The planner's private flag: NASR APT_BASE FACILITY_USE_CODE PR, not owned by the armed services.

military.description: A field the armed services own (OWNERSHIP_TYPE_CODE MA, MN, MR, CG): "military" where not open to the public, "joint" where it is (FACILITY_USE_CODE PU).

notam_id.description: NASR APT_BASE's NOTAM_ID: null or empty where it lists none.
